== History ==
Meesho Private Limited, formerly Fashnear Technologies Private Limited, was established by [[IIT Delhi]] graduates Vidit Aatrey and Sanjeev Barnwal in December, 2015<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Meesho Creates Stores for Indian SMBs Selling Through WhatsApp |url=https://www.ycombinator.com/blog/meesho |access-date=2023-05-17 |website=Y Combinator |language=en |archive-date=17 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230517102346/https://www.ycombinator.com/blog/meesho |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name=":0" /> In 2016, the founders came up with the idea of re-establishing the platform as Meesho, one that would enable country-wide shipping for resellers with the use of social media sites as tools for marketing.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Russell |first1=Jon |title=Meesho wants to make selling through WhatsApp more efficient and less painful |url=https://techcrunch.com/2016/08/17/meesho-wants-to-make-selling-through-whatsapp-more-efficient-and-less-painful/ |website=TechCrunch |access-date=26 August 2023 |location=Palo Alto, California |date=18 August 2016 |archive-date=10 September 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190910121238/https://techcrunch.com/2016/08/17/meesho-wants-to-make-selling-through-whatsapp-more-efficient-and-less-painful/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name=":0" />

In February 2019, the platform reported having around 209,000 users and about 1.2 million monthly orders, and in March 2020, it reported approximately 563,000 users and 3.1 million monthly orders.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-11-16 |title=Meesho logs 17.8 mn users in Sept; aims to reach 100 mn by Dec 2022 |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/entrepreneurship/news/story/meesho-logs-178-mn-users-in-sept-aims-to-reach-100-mn-by-dec-2022-312391-2021-11-16 |access-date=2023-05-17 |website=Business Today |language=en}}</ref><ref name="Purnell 2022 m212" /> In 2021, the Meesho mobile application was ranked among the most downloaded shopping apps globally.<ref name="Singh 2021 u399"/> In 2022, Meesho had about 120 million monthly users and about 910 million orders were made through the platform, with a [[gross merchandise value]] (GMV) of about $5 billion.<ref name=":3">{{Cite news |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-12-22 |title=With 910 million orders in 2022, Meesho grew 135% y-o-y |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/industry/with-910-million-orders-in-2022-meesho-grew-135-y-o-y/2922533/ |access-date=2023-05-17 |website=Financialexpress |language=en}}</ref>

According to report as of August 2023 Meesho delisted 42 lakh counterfeit listings and 10 lakh restricted products under its initiative Project Suraksha. During the same period, the platform blocked access for over 12,000 user accounts flagged for policy violations.<ref name="j046">{{cite web | title=Meesho delists 42 lakh counterfeit, 10 lakh restricted products in six months | website=CNBCTV18 | date=2 August 2023 | url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/startup/meesho-delists-42-lakh-counterfeit-10-lakh-restricted-products-in-six-months-17411281.htm | access-date=13 May 2025}}</ref> The Court granted injunctive relief by directing domain registrars to suspend the infringing websites. Additionally, the Court ordered law enforcement authorities to initiate criminal investigations, freeze associated financial accounts against the identified offenders.<ref name="m011" />

In 2023, Meesho became the fastest shopping app to cross over 500 million downloads.<ref>{{cite web |title=Meesho becomes world's fastest shopping app to cross 500 mn downloads |url=https://www.business-standard.com/amp/companies/news/meesho-becomes-world-s-fastest-shopping-app-to-cross-500-mn-downloads-123060100771_1.html |website=business-standard.com/ |publisher=Peerzada Abrar |access-date=1 June 2023 |archive-date=2 June 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230602092037/https://www.business-standard.com/amp/companies/news/meesho-becomes-world-s-fastest-shopping-app-to-cross-500-mn-downloads-123060100771_1.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

In 2024, Meesho introduced Valmo, a logistics marketplace, to provide shipment services to sellers by aggregating multiple logistics providers. Meesho employs over 3,000 small businesses and 10-12 large firms for warehousing and sorting operations within its logistics framework.<ref name="The Economic Times 2024 p785">{{cite web | title=Meesho launches logistics vertical Valmo | website=The Economic Times | date=2024-02-07 | url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/startups/meesho-launches-logistics-vertical-valmo-to-charge-under-a-rupee-per-order-for-services/articleshow/107500845.cms?from=mdr | access-date=2024-04-04}}</ref> According to media reports, Valmo operating in approximately 15,000 pincodes in India with around 6,000 partners. It is reported to handle over 50% of Meesho's daily orders.<ref name="h620">{{cite web | title=Meesho's logistics platform Valmo now handles 50% of orders, more than double from last year | website=Moneycontrol | date=26 March 2025 | url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/startup/meesho-s-logistics-platform-valmo-now-handles-50-of-orders-more-than-double-from-last-year-12976586.html | access-date=1 May 2025}}</ref>

In November 2024, Meesho introduced a generative AI-powered voice bot for customer support, managing approximately 60,000 calls daily in English and Hindi. According to media reports, the system resolves the majority of queries without human assistance, with only a small fraction of calls requiring manual intervention.<ref name="e794">{{cite web | last=Xavier | first=John | title=Meesho launches multilingual Gen AI-powered chatbot to handle shoppers' queries | website=The Hindu | date=26 November 2024 | url=https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/meesho-launches-multilingual-gen-ai-powered-chatbot-to-handle-shoppers-queries/article68913793.ece | access-date=1 May 2025 | archive-date=2 December 2024 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241202120709/https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/meesho-launches-multilingual-gen-ai-powered-chatbot-to-handle-shoppers-queries/article68913793.ece | url-status=live }}</ref>

According to media reports, in 2024, Meesho prevented over 22 million suspicious or potentially fraudulent transactions on its platform. The company initiated legal proceedings, resulting in the filing of twelve cases, including nine specifically targeting over forty individuals in the cities of Kolkata and Ranchi. The company filed a suit in the Delhi High Court for a permanent injunction against parties operating deceptive websites misappropriating its brand identity.<ref name="m011">{{cite web | title=Meesho acts against 2.2 crore suspicious transactions, lodges 12 cases in a year | website=Moneycontrol | date=18 November 2024 | url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/startup/meesho-acts-against-2-2-crore-suspicious-transactions-lodges-12-cases-in-a-year-12869562.html | access-date=8 June 2025}}</ref>

Meesha went public through an [[initial public offering]] in December 2025, raising $603 million.<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Joshi |first1=Ashutosh |last2=Mascarenhas |first2=Rajesh |date=10 December 2025 |title=India E-Commerce Upstart Meesho Jumps 60% After $603 Million IPO |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-12-10/meesho-to-debut-after-603-million-ipo-as-india-deals-hit-record |work=Bloomberg News}}</ref> It is listed on both the [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] and [[ National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Abrar |first=Peerzada |date=10 December 2025 |title=Meesho debuts on NSE, BSE; Prosus to hold 11.2% stake after listing |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/prosus-says-meesho-lists-on-nse-bse-retains-11-2-pc-stake-worth-about-1-bn-125121000485_1.html |work=Business Standard}}</ref>
==Recognition==
In 2023, Meesho was named one of the most influential companies of the year by [[Time (magazine)]].<ref>{{cite magazine |title=TIME100 MOST INFLUENTIAL COMPANIES 2023 |url=https://time.com/collection/time100-companies-2023/6285212/meesho/ |magazine=[[Time (magazine)|Time]] |publisher= |access-date=21 June 2023|last=Law|first=Tara|date=}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Meesho on TIME's 100 most influential companies |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/trends/meesho-on-times-100-most-influential-companies-10839501.html |website=moneycontrol.com/ |publisher=MONEYCONTROL NEWS |access-date=22 June 2023}}</ref>

extract: Meesho Limited (short for Meri shop, transl. My shop) is an Indian e-commerce company, headquartered in Bengaluru. Founded by Vidit Aatrey and Sanjeev Barnwal in December 2015, Meesho is an online marketplace in categories such as fashion, home and kitchen, beauty and personal care, electronics accessories, and daily use products.
